{"question":"The equation of a forced harmonic oscillator is 
\frac{d^2 x(t)}{dt^2} + 2\gamma \frac{dx(t)}{dt} + \omega_0^2 x(t) = \frac{F_0}{m} \sin(\Omega t)
What is the resonance frequency?
(here m, \gamma, \omega_0, \Omega, F_0 are positive constant)","options":{"A":"\Omega","B":"\frac{\Omega^2}{\omega_0}","C":"\omega_0","D":"\frac{\omega_0^2}{\Omega"},"correct":"C"}
